name: Charlotte's Speakeasy
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Dance Manhattan - Long Island swing dances list. Check the name and address; research the dance floor.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Name and address confirmed. The calendar widget calls Oct 2-3 'The Texas Blues Weekend' (a password theme), but the band list on the same page shows The Haymakers on Sat 10/3, matching our event. Entry may need a weekly password posted on the site. Hours are from the events page (open Fri-Sat; calendar shows 7 PM-midnight); not a separately published hours list. Only one usable photo: it is on the site's Media page, which also collects press clippings, so the original photographer might be a news outlet; owner may want to confirm. Logo file is large (3300 px). X/Twitter link from the site footer (twitter.com/charlotteseasy) may be inactive. Instagram linked from the site.
description: A Prohibition-style speakeasy bar in the cellar under Charlotte's dessert shop on Main Street in Farmingdale village, reached through a hidden bookcase door. It is open Friday and Saturday nights with live blues, jazz and swing bands, including The Haymakers swing band about once a month.

logo.alt: Charlotte's logo: a black ornate fleur-de-lis above the name Charlotte's in script

photos.alt: A narrow wooden staircase with warm lights leading down to the speakeasy's herringbone wood floor

evidence.note: Venue site contact page: 294 Main Street, Farmingdale, NY 11735, (516) 586-8530, info@charlottesspeakeasy.com.
Events page: open Friday and Saturday (except holidays), $5 cover, no hoodies or sneakers; band list includes The Haymakers on 10/3, 11/7 and 12/5.
About page: hidden bookcase door past Charlotte's Desserts' frozen yogurt; restored speakeasy opened by the DeVito brothers in November 2017.
Dance Manhattan's Long Island swing list (our source) points swing dancers to the Haymakers nights here.
